text: Thirty-one passengers walked off the ferry at dawn and never knew how close they had come.
Marlo knew. She waved at the lighthouse until her arm hurt.
On the north rocks, Gus found the yellow coat, folded neatly, a stone on top so the wind would not take it.
Under the stone, the brass key. And a fourth mark, freshly burned into the rock.
Four marks. Three ships. The sea was still owed one.
And Gus had just taken away the only person who knew how to pay it.
